newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Motor says unlikely to support Nissan Life.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Motor says unlikely to support Nissan Life.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd is unlikely to give significant support to failed Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co, Nissan Motor president Yoshikazu Hanawa told a news conference on Monday.
Nissan Motor is Nissan Life's second-largest client, although it has no equity links with the troubled life insurer.
"We have received no request from the life insurance association or the Finance Ministry (to aid Nissan Life) and we are not considering giving any support to Nissan Life," Hanawa said.
"At the moment, I don't think we can help Nissan Life. We may accept some excess personnel from them because of our long-term association with them, but I don't know if that is possible," he added.
